build_environment: dotnet SDK 8.0.400, TargetFramework net472, BepInEx 5 and the game's Unity modules supplied by -p:GameDir
notes: Reflection-only plugin: reads the currently active window/outfit/prop objects, writes BepInEx/config/SatoneStateCatalog/catalog.json and appearance_catalog.md, keeps one .bak
No Harmony patches, no save writes, no unlock or achievement changes
If the game updates and the plugin stops working, delete the DLL from BepInEx/plugins; the game is unaffected
